name: rose-petal-tub-high-fashion
image_vibe: Cinematic pink metallic couture in a warm luxury spa with rose petals, marble, steam, and botanical softness
image_purpose: Create a premium fashion campaign portrait for resort, beauty, or luxury lifestyle use.

prompt.project_info: A 3:4 ultra-realistic full-body high-fashion editorial portrait of an original adult woman seated on the edge of a freestanding white marble bathtub in a luxury resort spa bathroom.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with blonde wavy hair, natural realistic skin texture with visible pores and subtle glow, and a composed confident editorial expression. She wears a pink metallic tailored mini dress with an asymmetric high-fashion design, elegant neckline, controlled side openings, and body-skimming construction, plus a small gold clutch, gold hoop earrings, red teardrop pendant, stacked gold bangles, and strappy gold crystal-accented sandals. Keep the styling non-explicit and fashion-editorial.
prompt.composition_elements: Low-angle full-body framing, subject seated on the edge of the freestanding white marble bathtub with a slight backward lean, one hand on the tub rim, legs crossed in a bold editorial pose, rose-petal-filled bathwater, light steam, lush green indoor plants, large frosted windows, and the tub as the primary environmental anchor.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft golden ambient lighting with cinematic shadows and highlights, warm luxury resort-spa atmosphere, reflective marble and metallic fabric accents, gentle steam diffusion, and natural botanical contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 full-body composition, photorealistic high-fashion editorial photography, low-angle camera, 85mm lens, f/2.8, realistic skin, hair, metallic fabric, marble, petals, glass, jewelry, and steam texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 3:4 ultra-realistic full-body high-fashion editorial portrait of an original adult woman with blonde wavy hair, natural realistic skin texture with visible pores and subtle glow, and a composed confident expression. Seat her on the edge of a freestanding white marble bathtub in a high-end resort spa bathroom, with a slight backward lean, one hand resting on the tub rim, and legs crossed in a bold but non-explicit fashion pose. Dress her in a pink metallic tailored mini dress with an asymmetric high-fashion design, elegant neckline, controlled side openings, and body-skimming construction. Add a small gold clutch, gold hoop earrings, a red teardrop pendant necklace, stacked gold bangles, and strappy gold crystal-accented sandals. Fill the bathwater with rose petals and include light steam, lush green indoor plants, and large frosted windows. Use soft golden ambient lighting, cinematic shadows and highlights, low-angle camera, an 85mm lens at f/2.8, realistic skin, hair, metallic fabric, marble, petals, jewelry, and steam texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, luxury resort-spa fashion photography, and no text or watermark.
